div.div: أَمْرٌ بَاهِظٌ A distressing, grievous, or difficult, affair. (S, CK, but wanting in two MS. copies of the K.) And بَاهِظٌ [alone], (CK, but wanting in two MS. copies of the K,) or ↓ بَاهِظَةٌ , (O, TA,) (tropical:) A calamity, or misfortune. (O, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
